title: WIRED Newsletters blocked as spam
summary: Sometime in the last week, my WIRED email newsletters which are automatically forwarded to NewsBlur started getting blocked as spam. Help?
body_markdown:
[mtaylor](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/mtaylor)


September 13, 2026, 1:05pm 1


Sometime in the last week, my WIRED email newsletters which are automatically forwarded to NewsBlur started getting blocked as spam. Help?


[Spam detection on newsletters too strict](https://forum.newsblur.com/t/spam-detection-on-newsletters-too-strict/13413/4)


[leonick](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/leonick)


September 13, 2026, 7:15pm 2


Where are they getting blocked?


If they’re getting blocked at your email account before being forwarded you need to mark them as safe there. Open a mail from your spam box and you should have an option to mark it as not spam.


I don’t think Newsblur has a spam-filter on the newsletter feature.


[mtaylor](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/mtaylor)


September 13, 2026, 9:18pm 3


I do think its NewsBlur, because I’m getting emails like this:


Mail Delivery Subsystem


Message blocked


Your message to \[redacted\] @newsletters.newsblur.com


has been blocked. See technical details below for more information.
The response from the remote server was:


550 5.7.1 Message considered as SPAM (Score of 5.0/5.0 with BITCOIN_YOUR_INFO, DKIMWL_WL_HIGH, DKIM_SIGNED, DKIM_VALID, DKIM_VALID_AU, DMARC_PASS, HTML_FONT_LOW_CONTRAST, HTML_IMAGE_RATIO_04, HTML_MESSAGE, SPF_HELO_NONE, THIS_AD) - ImprovMX v2026.09.11


[samuelclay](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/samuelclay)


September 13, 2026, 11:14pm 4


Found the cause, that bounce is coming from ImprovMX, the service that receives mail for[newsletters.newsblur.com](http://newsletters.newsblur.com/) and hands it to NewsBlur. They pushed an update on September 11 and their spam scoring now puts some WIRED emails right at the 5.0 cutoff, so the message gets rejected before it ever reaches NewsBlur. Your WIRED newsletters were arriving every day up through the 11th and then stopped, which matches. Nothing changed on your end or in NewsBlur.


I’ve asked ImprovMX to turn off spam filtering for our domain, since every newsletter address already has a secret token in it and the mail only goes to NewsBlur. I’ll update here when I hear back.
